item.description:
Answers say Sent, and Perch works with Conductor and Warp
- An answer from the notch or a card now says Sent with a paper plane, or Didn't send if it reached nothing - Conductor workspaces show up in the list and Pick up opens them in Conductor - Pick up in Warp lands on the session's tab

Lists and code read better in a reply
- Bullet and numbered lists in a reply draw with their markers, nested as written, even with no blank line before them - Code in a reply takes your character's colour - Paragraphs and lists in a reply have a clearer gap between them - Another app's shortcut that shares Perch's modifiers (Command+Option+Shift+L, say) no longer opens Perch

Choose which screen Perch opens on
- Show Perch on in Settings: the screen with the mouse, the screen with the active window, or one display by name - A chosen display that is unplugged stays in the menu, greyed, and Perch follows the mouse until it is back - Hover opens on external displays now lives in the Show Perch on menu - On a display without a notch, the card and the live activity close by shrinking to nothing at the top centre - A failed update says why and what to do (move Perch to Applications, check your connection), and a Mac that cannot run the newest version is told so - Settings has more room between its rows
